description: This file contains the implementation of the jScrollPane plugin, a JavaScript library for customizable scrollbars in web pages. It includes license information, plugin setup, and methods for initializing and managing scrollbars, including vertical and horizontal scrollbars, arrow buttons, and event handling.

classes.name: JScrollPane
classes.description: Main class for managing custom scrollbars, handling initialization, scrollbar sizing, event binding, and content scrolling.

methods.name: initialise
methods.description: Initializes the scrollbar setup, calculates sizes, and binds events based on settings.

methods.name: initialiseVerticalScroll
methods.description: Sets up the vertical scrollbar if content overflows vertically.

methods.name: sizeVerticalScrollbar
methods.description: Adjusts the size and position of the vertical scrollbar.

methods.name: initialiseHorizontalScroll
methods.description: Sets up the horizontal scrollbar if content overflows horizontally.

methods.name: sizeHorizontalScrollbar
methods.description: Adjusts the size and position of the horizontal scrollbar.

methods.name: resizeScrollbars
methods.description: Resizes and repositions scrollbars when container size changes.

methods.name: appendArrows
methods.description: Adds arrow buttons to scrollbars based on position settings.

methods.name: getArrowScroll
methods.description: Returns a function to handle arrow button scrolling.

methods.name: arrowScroll
methods.description: Performs scrolling when arrow buttons are pressed.

methods.name: initClickOnTrack
methods.description: Initializes click events on scrollbar tracks for page scrolling.
